dedupe_keys.name: national critical infrastructure protection programme of poland npoik government centre for security

description: The Polish Government Centre for Security (RCB) publishes the National Critical Infrastructure Protection Programme (Narodowy Program Ochrony Infrastruktury Krytycznej, NPOIK) and its public annexes. The page offers the programme's main document of 2013 and the consolidated texts of 2015, 2018 and 2020 and later, each with an annex describing the critical infrastructure systems and an annex of standards for the proper functioning of critical infrastructure, written as good practices and recommendations, all as PDF files. RCB's critical infrastructure pages explain that under the Polish crisis management act critical infrastructure means the systems and functionally linked objects, including buildings, equipment, installations and services, key to the security of the state and its citizens, and that the detailed criteria for deciding whether an object belongs to it are in a classified annex of the programme. The documents are free to download; text content on gov.pl is published under CC BY-SA 4.0. Caveats: the documents are in Polish, and the criteria and lists of designated objects are classified. Coverage is Poland. It supports the definition of critical infrastructure systems and interdependencies for resilience and cascading failure studies; related records are the Ireland National Risk Assessment 2023 and the Korean national core infrastructure statistics.
